subject.title: Gateway becomes slow or times out under multi-session / multi-agent load

question: What gateway heavy-load reliability target is required before this issue can close?
rationale: Partial fixes have landed, but the acceptance bar for live-load proof, latency budgets, and whether this remains one umbrella or becomes per-handler follow-ups is a maintainer reliability decision.

options.title: Keep umbrella until proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a large-state gateway proof covers status, stability, logs.tail, chat.history, sessions.compact, auth status, and message delivery latency together.

options.title: Split remaining handlers
options.body: Create narrower canonical issues for the remaining slow handlers and close this only after those issues link and preserve the reporter's evidence.

options.title: Accept current mitigations
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the merged session-list, log-tail, and compact seam work is enough despite the missing full workload replay.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella until proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a large-state gateway proof covers status, stability, logs.tail, chat.history, sessions.compact, auth status, and message delivery latency together.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans gateway and session reliability scope rather than one contributor's narrow fix, and this handle appears in recent gateway/session history and the issue timeline.
